description: 30 Minute Timer helps users start visual countdown timers inside ChatGPT or create persistent fullscreen web timer links. Users can choose minute or second durations, visual backgrounds, progress icons, final text, sound family, halfway alerts, repeat sound, and timer controls such as pause, resume, stop, and restart.
